said.q: Sunshine Bridge uses William Carlos Williams’ epic poem Paterson --which explores man’s relationship to the city-- as the backdrop that unifies his two-panel composition. The panel on the left depicts faint geometric blocks, resembling stairs, that lead to an enigmatic closed cellar doorway.
